$comment: Single source of truth for every version platform-pkg-dev pins. Edit here, then release platform-pkg-dev and run `dev sync` in each package.
$packageManagerComment: Must be at least 10.26.1. pnpm 10.26.0 shipped two days before pnpm/pnpm#10327 landed, and without that fix blockExoticSubdeps misreads any subdependency with a wildcard `*` specifier as exotic - which vitest has several of. It failed installs with 'resolved via undefined' and sometimes a package name that does not exist.
$toolsComment: The only external executable a developer installs. pre-commit then installs every hook below into its own isolated environment at the pinned rev, so semgrep, checkov and detect-secrets never need to be on PATH.
$hookRevsComment: Hook repo revisions for .pre-commit-config.yaml. The rev is the version. Do not run `pre-commit autoupdate` - bump here and run `dev sync`.
$versionUrlComment: Where `dev sync` looks for the latest platform-pkg-dev version: a plain-text file containing just the version, served next to start.sh. Override with DEV_VERSION_URL. Set to null to disable the check.
$workspaceSettingsComment: Supply-chain settings platform-pkg-dev owns in each package pnpm-workspace.yaml. minimumReleaseAge is in MINUTES (10080 = 7 days): pnpm refuses any release younger than that, which is the window most malicious publishes are caught in. Note this constrains platform-pkg-dev itself - every version pinned above must be at least that old, including the platform binaries published alongside tools like oxlint, or a package cannot install its own toolchain.
